objective: Close the minimum C2 memory-latency sensitivity using the frozen H67 ep35 FC2 population and the only fair comparator: typed signed K8 versus equal-bandwidth replicated K1x8.

population.checkpoint_identity: H67 ep35 as frozen by M216/M218
population.operator_scope: all 120 H67 ep35 mlp.fc2 records in the frozen ten-sample population

fair_model.comparison: typed signed K8 versus equal-bandwidth K1x8 only
fair_model.maximum_bank_accept_rate_each: one request per bank per cycle
fair_model.response_policy: fixed latency, in order within each bank, no external request/response stall
fair_model.shared_frontend_schedule: the exact SOURCE_CAP=8 lane-aligned H67 group schedule already materialized and payload-checked by M218
fair_model.structural_equivalence: for this memory-service-only model, each K8 bundle and the eight K1x8 scalar lanes consume the same active-bank request multiset on the same per-bank ports; the critical lane count of K1x8 is therefore the same max-per-bank group count used by K8
fair_model.context_hazard: reuse the M218 O8/II1 fixed-latency recurrence; M218 reports zero context-hazard cycles at L1/L2/L4
fair_model.common_tail: six result beats per output block plus one done beat per token, already charged in the pinned M218 service cycles

required_outputs.points: L1/L2/L4 K8 and K1x8 service cycles, equal-bandwidth cycle ratio, latency degradation versus L1, and area-normalized throughput using M903 logic-only areas
required_outputs.stage_table: retain frozen per-stage work identities and L4 K8 service sensitivity; do not invent per-stage L1/L2 values absent from the pinned producer
required_outputs.direct_replay_audit: state explicitly whether raw M803/K1x8 cycle-accurate full-trace replay exists
required_outputs.blocker: if it does not, state the exact missing artifact and minimum capture command/interface

forbidden: Compare K8 against a single K1 as the M911 headline
Interpret the M911 1.0x equal-bandwidth cycle envelope as a regression or as a system result
Use directed M803 cycle ratios to inflate the 120-record latency points
Call M903 logic-only ZeroWireload area physical SRAM area or paper-ready PPA
Claim a direct M803 full-trace replay without a serialized raw4 transaction stream and a cycle-calibrated M803/K1x8 CPU model or a bounded VCS replay
